notices.title: Game Not Available
notices.message: This game is currently unavailable for download. Our team has disabled access to this game, because the game may no longer work properly due to one of several possible issues: DRM protection, online connectivity features have been patched, or the download sources have become inaccessible. If you have information suggesting this game is working again, please contact our support team.

notices.title: Beta Access Required
notices.message: This game is currently in early access and may have stability issues. Please report any problems to our support team.
